message:
♦️ FLEX GUI PRO V9.0.0 IS LIVE!

This massive release brings zero-config Flex AI Cloud & Image Generation, the brand-new Per-Word AutoCaption Motion Editor, 11 SaaS Text Animators (including Bounce Down), interactive Proximity Effector Rigs, Precomp to Content, and full Extension Viewport Customization.

Here is what is new:

♦️ Zero-Config Flex AI Cloud & Image Generation
♦️ Automatic License Linking: Flex AI now activates automatically from your existing panel license—no API keys, Ollama installations, or manual setup required.
♦️ Auto-Renewing Sessions: Eliminated session dropouts. The panel quietly re-links itself in the background so you never lose connection.
♦️ In-Panel Image Generation: Generate assets directly inside the panel using your Flex AI credits, with automatic format detection, honest transparency failure reporting, and direct AE import.
♦️ Zero-Clutter UI: Removed 28 legacy/local third-party models and background RAM meters in favor of a clean, dedicated Flex AI credit banner with instant refresh.

♦️ Rebuilt AutoCaptions & Per-Word Motion Editor
♦️ Pinned Live Preview & Tabbed UI: Live preview is now pinned to the top of the panel across STYLE, TEXT, and MOTION tabs, featuring a 4-across template gallery grid.
♦️ Per-Word Motion Engine: Assign custom IN and OUT transitions (Slide, Bounce, Pop, Fade) with an 8-way directional pad to individual words, groups, or the entire caption line.
♦️ Stylized Word FX: Apply Shake, Jitter, Motion Blur, Flicker, and Blur to specific words with adjustable duration and travel distance, writing real, retimable AE keyframes.
♦️ True Hinglish Transcripts: Fixed Hinglish captioning to return authentic Hindi in Roman script across segments, full text, and word timestamps.

♦️ 11 SaaS Text Animators (Text ▸ SaaS)
♦️ New "Bounce Down" Animator: Added springy drop-and-settle overshoot physics to the SaaS text library, bringing the total to 11 native After Effects text animators.
♦️ True Cascade Motion: Maintains fluid 3 to 4 character cascading across lines of any length, with hover-to-preview cards and stackable layering (e.g., Light Sweep over Blur In).
♦️ Full Scope & Retiming: Choose between Chars / Words / Lines and In / Out / In&Out with all keyframes placed directly on your timeline for manual adjustment.

♦️ Proximity Effector Rigs (8 Templates)
♦️ 8 Dynamic Rigs: Drift Wall, Flat Marquee, Option Wheel, Spotlight Grid, Tilt Cards, Chroma Grid, Cursor Trail, and Text Pressure.
♦️ True Expression Stage Previews: Hovering over the panel stage runs the exact After Effects expression in real time, serving as an interactive controller null before you build.
♦️ Single-Null Timeline Control: The entire procedural animation is driven and animated by one master controller null.

♦️ Precomp To Content & Workspace Customization
♦️ Alt + Click PRECOMP SEP: Precomposes selected layers tightly cropped to their visible artwork bounds rather than the full comp canvas, shifting keyframes together without breaking motion.
♦️ Toggle Edit Mode: Customize, reorganize, and scale the extension's entire viewport directly from Flex Settings.
♦️ Update-Safe Profile Storage: Custom expressions, saved eases, favorites, and panel layouts now automatically back up to ~/.flexgui alongside your license to survive reinstallation.

♦️ Performance & Fixes
♦️ Instant Panel Launch: AutoCaptions queries the AE font API directly without generating temporary comp layers, eliminating startup lag and screen flicker.
♦️ Graph Editor Layout: Opens with the preset library pinned beside the curve editor by default, keeping APPLY visible at all times.
